scope: Existing staging testnet; unchanged SDK and NEAR-only harness; no new resources.
method: Sequential control/candidate/control; three fresh NEAR-only wallets and 21 verified signatures per arm. Frozen SDK, Gateway, runtime and role keys. Existing staging resources only.
decision: Retain the smaller B start path and request-local authenticated root reuse. Observed preparation CPU fell; no repeatable end-to-end latency improvement is established.

roundTrips.scope: Bound-root role-private D1 only, excluding root creation, other D1 operations and local DO SQL.
roundTrips.reason: Verify the encrypted row before persisting admission, then read the admission and active-root snapshot atomically. Execution reads fresh cancellation state.

limitations: Three fresh wallets per arm; sequential conditions vary. These samples do not establish a percentile, guaranteed saving, or setup regression.
Control-before ran while the native release build finished. Candidate and control-after ran after the builds and local E2Es completed. Cloudflare CPU measurements are independent of the local build.
Application clocks freeze during CPU work. Zero-millisecond B-start and JSON-decode spans do not mean zero CPU cost.
Fetch-to-headers spans include receiver processing, storage/output gates and transport. They do not isolate physical network time.
Actual Worker and DO execution locations were not measured. The existing authenticated APAC placement hints remain unchanged.
Six D1 calls and sixteen statements count only bound-root loads. Null Gateway counters are unavailable, not zero.
The 1–2 second hosted setup target remains unmet.

reproduction.local: Build the five strict release Workers at the source commit, then run each localVerification command with ROUTER_AB_WORKER_BUILD_PROFILE=release.
reproduction.hosted: .artifacts/r155b-phase6m-hosted/run.py runs the frozen NEAR-only harness with guarded versions, candidate deployment after local verification, two controls and finally restoration.
